# Top Cottage Tour
Home Of Franklin D Roosevelt National Historic Site
This event has already occurred. This page is provided for reference only. 
  * Every week on Sunday and Saturday at 10:00 AM, 1:00 PM, and 3:00 PM from May 30, 2026 to August 14, 2026 
  * Fees apply 


Tours of Top Cottage have officially begun! Experience the serene hideaway that Franklin D. Roosevelt constructed at the pinnacle of Dutchess Hill. On the same porch where FDR entertained King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, you can contemplate the private thoughts of the 32nd President with the guidance of a park ranger.
More information 
## Fees
The cost of each space is a $10 amenity fee which an NPS America the Beautiful pass will NOT cover.
## Reservation or Registration
Tickets are available only in-person at the Henry A. Wallace Visitor Center at 4079 Albany Post Rd, Hyde Park, NY 12538 on the day of your desired tour. S

# Rethinking the Fall Garden Cleanup
Home Of Franklin D Roosevelt National Historic Site
Special Event 
  * Oct 24, 2026 at 10:30 AM 
  * Fees apply 


Register 
The event is hosted by park partner, the Beatrix Farrand Garden Association, and they require prior registration online for this event under multiple ticket options.
Join ecological landscape designer Ashley Gamell, director of horticulture for the Beatrix Farrand Garden Association, for a captivating garden walk as she explores the fall season's potential to enhance garden beauty and extend blooms into the winter, all while sustaining a vibrant ecosystem. In this session, Ashley will spotlight stunning fall bloomers in both the walled and wild gardens and share her insights on a mindful approach to garden cleanup that fosters biodiversity throughout the year.
More information 
## Fees
Tickets are $16.66. Tickets are free for BFGA members.
